verdict.rationale: A probe found an official Plaid MCP server, which would let an AI agent drive Plaid from natural-language commands, and an llms.txt is served to help LLMs read the docs. Nothing shows that the MCP server covers Identity Verification operations, and there is no built-in natural-language interface. The no-code workflow editor is visual, not natural language. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes IDV actions (sessions, retries, overrides, templates), any native natural-language command interface, and hands-on or independent confirmation of natural-language operation.
